httpExemption: Shipping has no HTTP surface at all (§3.2): its chart renders no Service, no route reaches it, and its only listener is §13.5's health endpoint, which the http templates exclude by route. A declared http signal would read a series that is empty by construction, and an empty result rolls every rung back, so the rollout could only ever fail. Its events arrive on the broker and are judged by consume. The two workers are where this service's risk sits and neither is a consumer, so the carrier and address calls carry no canary signal of their own — the signals docs/runbooks/queue-backlog.md names for them watch them, outside the rollout.
